props.name: loading
props.description: Blocks the trigger while the options load.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the error style. Same as passing aria-invalid.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets the user pick several options; state moves to `values`.

props.name: indicator
props.description: How a selected option is marked: a check mark or a checkbox square.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `toolbar` is a ghost trigger showing the current option's icon and label, sized for a Toolbar. It drops the Clear row and marks the pick on the right.

props.name: variant
props.description: Trigger surface, matching TextField. Ignored by the toolbar appearance.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to `sm` (h-7), the height Select has always had.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Adds a filter box at the top of the list.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear button to the trigger once something is selected.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: With `multiple`, shows selected options as tags up to this many, then "N selected". 0 always shows the count.
